source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current DBViewWrapper.close takes an options object, not the historical boolean argument. leavingFolder false skips onLeavingFolder callbacks and avoids EndFolderLoading calling back into deleted storage. _folderDeleted uses that mode for its displayed folder. It also ignores Trash-folder deletion notifications used during empty-trash. Preserve these exceptions when adjusting deletion cleanup; they are separate from clearing visible message selection.
title: Treat deleted-folder close differently from an ordinary folder switch
